verifiedCheckpoint.name: ACTIVE-SPACE-CHECKLIST-TOGGLE-GREEN
verifiedCheckpoint.meaning: The behavior-traced active-Space checklist-item toggle passed independent review and all exact-commit CI jobs, including traceability, 426 disposable-database assertions, the full 690-test isolated target suite, and macOS/iOS builds; hosted authenticated Sync and revocation remain outside its completed local scope under A-003/A-004.

activeWorkflow.outcome: Edit the complete checklist structure and text for one represented active Project or Business Inventory Space in an isolated draft, then cancel without mutation or save one durable revision-bound replacement with conflict recovery.
nextActions: Commit and push the verified read-only recovery checkpoint, then run the exact CI gates.
After immutable CI passes, advance the verified checkpoint while leaving active-space-checklist-editor explicitly blocked on O-051.
Select and begin the next unblocked Product Behavior Catalog workflow; do not add rejected-operation retry, dismissal, acknowledgment or resolution until O-051 is approved.

progress.note: Workflow counts measure product progress. The checklist toggle is locally complete and exact-commit verified; the full checklist editor is the active catalogued user workflow. The surface catalog is a passive completeness audit, not a completion percentage.

blockers: A canonical production export or approved read-only access is required for production-profile and migration evidence.
Hosted Supabase and PowerSync resources, credentials, spending, and authenticated rehearsal require explicit user authorization.
O-026 must be approved before Project creation can be cutover-ready because its final project-budget command authorization, RLS, and Sync policy remain provisional.
O-051 must be approved before a rejected operation can be retried or acknowledged as resolved; read-only exact recovery may proceed without inventing that policy.
A-003 and A-004 remain proposed until the complete vertical-spike exit gate passes.
guardrails: Do not implement redesigned behavior in Firebase.
Do not access or mutate production systems or production data.
Do not create paid or hosted resources, migrate data, freeze Firebase, release, or cut over without explicit user approval.

resume.instruction: Continue the active workflow from nextActions. Load only its named authority sections and affected code until a concrete discrepancy requires broader history.
